description: 10 AI agents modeled after computing pioneers — a Brooksian surgical team for architecture, implementation, review, and infrastructure. Brooks orchestrates, Jobs gates intent, Woz builds, Pike reviews, Scout reconnoiters, Bellard diagnoses, Carmack optimizes, Fowler refactors, Knuth architects data, Hightower deploys.

interface.shortDescription: 10 AI agents: Brooks, Jobs, Woz, Pike, Scout, Bellard, Carmack, Fowler, Knuth, Hightower
interface.longDescription: A Brooksian surgical team of 10 AI agents, each modeled after a computing pioneer. Instead of 10 generalists, you get one architect (Brooks) and nine specialists who own their domains completely. Install this plugin to get role-based agent routing for architecture, implementation, code review, performance, data design, and infrastructure.
